shortDescription: Retrive information on a virtual directory in IIS

options.name: application
options.description: The name of the IIS web application to retrieve the virtual directories from. If unset, all website virtual directories will be returned.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the virtual directory to get the information for. If unset, all virtual directories will be returned.

options.name: site
options.description: The name of the IIS website to retrieve the virtual directories from. If unset, all website virtual directories will be returned.
